description: Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-17F recorded at the Yemen Military Museum on Jamal Abdul Nasser Street in Sana'a. Identity and serial come from aviationmuseum.eu, whose Yemen page predates the worst of the war; spottingmode's location entry says only MiG-17, more? and links no airframe. Esri imagery of 7 October 2025 shows the museum compound standing but resolves no aircraft outdoors, so it may be indoors or may be gone. Existed before 2015; current state unknown. This is the only aircraft in the whole of Yemen that could be given a serial.
